sources.title: Wan2.2-T2V-A14B: Text-to-Video model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Wan2.2-T2V-A14B generates 5-second videos from text prompts at 480P and 720P resolutions, built by Wan-AI using a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 27B total parameters but only 14B active per inference step. The model uses a diffusion-based video generation framework with specialized expert models: a high-noise expert for early denoising stages focusing on overall layout ...
